fields.label: Skill Code
fields.description: Stable uppercase business code, for example MIXING or KETTLE-OP.

fields.label: Skill Category
fields.description: Reusable grouping such as Production, Quality, Safety, Maintenance, or Logistics.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive skills remain in historical competency records but cannot receive new approvals.

fields.label: Certification Reference Required
fields.description: A submitted Employee Competency must identify its supporting certificate or assessment reference.

fields.label: Expiry Date Required
fields.description: A submitted Employee Competency must have a Valid Until date.

fields.label: Default Validity (Days)
fields.description: Planning aid only. Zero means the approving manager must enter the validity date explicitly.

fields.label: External Standard / SOP Reference
fields.description: Neutral identifier only. It does not create a dependency on TrackQMS or any other application.
